description: Shape of one entry in memory/TASK_HISTORY.md. Deliberately not JSON Schema: nothing in the agent validates records against a machine schema, and a schema that is never enforced is documentation pretending to be a contract. This file states the shape so a future agent can write a conforming record. No test loads it: the memory tests assert behaviour (precedence, staleness, redaction idempotence, and that memory cannot reach routing), not record field lists.

properties.note: ISO-8601 date or date-time. Required by the freshness rule (10.17): a record with no date cannot be classified, only guessed at.
The task text as the human gave it, unedited. Editing it destroys the only evidence that the router had to work with real phrasing rather than a tidy one.
{ intent, categories[], surface[], confidence, confidenceWhy }. Confidence is required so a wrong classification can be recognised later rather than quietly inherited.
Record ids retrieved from this layer before the work started. An empty array is a valid and informative answer: it means memory had nothing to offer.
{ files, relevant, irrelevant, expandedBy, sizePolicy } — the bundle the router produced. Kept so retrieval can be scored against what was actually loaded.
{ inspected[], modified[], created[], deleted[] }. Paths only; no file contents.
What actually changed and why, in prose. Free text on purpose — see CHANGE_RECORD_SCHEMA.json for the structured form used when the change was non-trivial.
{ commands[{ name, result }], tests, builds }. `result` records observed output, not intent, so a later reader can tell 'ran and passed' from 'assumed'.
COMPLETED | PARTIAL | BLOCKED | ABANDONED. PARTIAL must say what remains.
What went wrong. An empty array on a real task is a smell, not a success.
Ids into memory/LESSONS_LEARNED.md. Cross-reference, never a copy.
Ids into memory/ARCHITECTURAL_DECISIONS.md, or into tasks/ROUTER_DECISIONS.md where the detail lives.
What was deliberately not done, and why. An empty array is allowed; silently dropping work is not.

Freshness class (10.17). A task record is normally HISTORICAL the moment it is written: it describes a past event and is never re-verified against code. CURRENT is reserved for records that make a claim about the present.
Where the record came from: the agent and session that produced it, plus the commit if one exists. Without provenance a record cannot be audited.
Id of the record or the current source that contradicts this one. Required when status is SUPERSEDED — a superseded record with no successor is just a deletion with extra steps.
What current evidence disagrees, and where. Required when status is SUPERSEDED.

invariants: No credentials, tokens, keys, or connection strings. Scanned by scripts/secret-scan.mjs once tracked.
No verbatim secret-shaped values even as examples; describe the shape instead.
Every field marked required is present even when empty — an absent key and an empty list mean different things.
Records are append-only. A correction adds a new record or sets `supersededBy`; it never edits history in place.
`memoryConsulted` is written before the work, not reconstructed after it.
